g00.summary: Won on turn 18 with two incidents: three supply centers and the North America recon.
g00.story: Vex led as Knox, a Laborer out of Southreach. Sol played Hale, a Radio Operator, and Kit played Sable, an Instructor. Four cubes went on each of the nine cities. Hale spent the opening restocking the cities the Infection deck pointed at and moved cubes to Knox from across the map. Knox built Jacksonville and Washington as a Laborer, with Sable feeding him blue cards, and reconned North America from Washington, which put Chicago on the grid. Sable drew the year's first supply line, Washington to Atlanta, and Hale drew Lagos to Istanbul. The third center went up in Istanbul and ended the game.
highlights: First win of the year, a month ahead of North America's forced opening.
Three jobs working as a chain: the Radio Operator moved cubes at range, the Instructor passed any card, the Laborer built with four cards and two cubes.
Quiet Night skipped an Infect step at the right moment. This was the event that misfired in the first run.
Two supply lines drawn in the game the action unlocked: Washington to Atlanta and Lagos to Istanbul.
Game end: 5 production units bought a Triple improvement on a Washington card, Helmsman for Knox, and Well Stocked on a Washington Infection card.
g00.parity: All four checks against the research passed: 2 objectives required, Build 3 supply centers (mandatory) and Recon North America in play, 36 cubes. Legacy card 01-01 was read at setup and 01-02 at game end, both in January. The recon opened North America and unlocked Supply Line and Search, as scheduled. Atlanta and Chicago's Infection cards went to the Game End area, which is the research rule for a city that joins mid-game.

findings.finding: Deliver, Pick Up and Transfer offered only one cube or the whole stack. A player who wanted 3 of 5 cubes had to take all 5.
findings.fix: Every count is offered. Test added.

findings.finding: A Laborer holding five blue cards was offered one 4-card build, so the game chose which card he kept.
findings.fix: Every set of cards that wastes none is offered for supply centers and recons. Test added.

findings.finding: Supply Line was unlocked but invisible while the player held 1 cube, so it looked locked.
findings.fix: The options list now names unlocked actions that are not possible right now, with their costs.

findings.finding: Re-sending the event picks that were already chosen answered REFUSED.
findings.fix: It answers ok and says nothing changed.

findings.finding: The city view listed a link that already existed as a possible new link.
findings.fix: Existing links and unrevealed cities are left out.

findings.finding: A new city's Player cards were in the discard pile and its Infection cards were nowhere to be seen.
findings.fix: The research rule. The decks view now shows the Game End area where those Infection cards wait.

findings.finding: The Laborer could transfer cubes to the Radio Operator at range on his own turn.
findings.fix: Kept. The research says only that Transfer works between locations for the Radio Operator. The guide now says so.

findings.finding: No permanent structures for sale after a win.
findings.fix: They unlock in February. Guide corrected.

g01.summary: Won on turn 12 with five incidents: three supply centers, and Los Angeles and Denver joined to the grid.
g01.story: Sol led with a new character, Reed the Farmer, and Kit benched the Instructor for Quinn, an Administrator. Vex kept Knox the Laborer, now with Helmsman. Reed filled every city to its population. The opening infection hit London three times and Reed refilled it. The first epidemic stripped São Paulo, and Quinn played Resilience in the new pause before the reshuffle. Quinn pulled pawns together in Lagos so Knox could collect yellow cards and build São Paulo, then built Washington himself with the Triple card bought in January. Knox drew supply lines to Los Angeles and Denver, which completed the second objective, searched Atlanta, and built the Atlanta center for the win.
highlights: Second straight win, in 12 turns. Rationing is now 0, so March starts with no Rationed Events.
First Search of the year: Atlanta, which let the table set a São Paulo Infection card aside.
The Epidemic pause added after the first run was used as intended: Resilience played on the city that had just been struck.
The Triple improvement paid for a supply center on its own with two more cards.
Game end: Washington's center was made permanent, the first permanent structure of the year. Record Keeper went to Knox and Double to a London card.
g01.parity: All four checks passed: 2 objectives required; Build 3 supply centers (mandatory), Recon a new area and Connect 2 new cities in play; 33 cubes. Legacy card 02-01 was read at setup. North America was already open, so its perimeter report forced nothing. Card 02-02 was read at game end and put permanent supply centers on sale, added three Rationed Events and armed the two turning points, as the research schedules.

findings.finding: Resilience says up to 2 cards of one city, but only one card could be named, so the second São Paulo card went back on the deck.
findings.fix: Pairs of cards of one city are offered. Test added.

findings.finding: The briefing said three new events had arrived without naming them, and a held event showed only its name.
findings.fix: A briefing now names every new card with its rule, in the game and in the lab. The lab's status lists each held event with what it does.

findings.finding: A search that found a choice logged only a code word, and the choice itself was not logged.
findings.fix: The game logs what was set aside, taken or removed. The lab describes each kind of find in plain words.

findings.finding: Only the lead could see the shop at game end.
findings.fix: Every player can read the shop. Only the lead can buy.

findings.finding: Placing 3 cubes with 2 left answered 'Not that many cubes', which read as a population cap.
findings.fix: The game says how many cubes are left to place.

findings.finding: Cities that joined mid-game put cards with unused search boxes into the discard pile, out of reach.
findings.fix: The research rule. They are drawn next game.

g02.summary: Lost on turn 16 at eight incidents, with one supply center of three built. First loss of the run.
g02.story: Kit led as Quinn the Administrator, Vex kept Knox the Laborer and Sol returned to Hale the Radio Operator. Two wins had driven rationing to 0, so the deck held no event cards at all, and March asks for three objectives. Knox joined San Francisco from Denver and Mexico City from Los Angeles in the first turns, which completed Connect 2 new cities. Quinn built the London center, where the Double card counted as two. After that the table spent its actions on armour: Knox produced at Southreach, Hale carried cubes across the map, and four epidemics kept stripping what they placed. São Paulo took a second Plague cube on turn 16 and filled the track.
highlights: The price of winning: rationing 0 meant no Quiet Night, no Supply Drop, no Resilience. The table lost the kind of game its events had been winning.
Connect 2 new cities done by turn 3, with supply lines to San Francisco and Mexico City.
The Double improvement bought in February paid for part of the London center.
The permanent Washington center from February was standing at setup, as bought.
Game end: card 03-02 unlocked Sea Lanes, epidemic scaling, three scars and the Foreman ability. The table bought Lockdown and two population.
g02.parity: All four checks passed: 3 objectives required; Build 3 supply centers (mandatory), Recon a new area, Connect 2 new cities, Perform 2 searches and Access a lost haven in play; 30 cubes. Card 03-01 was read at setup and 03-02 at game end. South America's perimeter report was a warning only this month, as the research says, and forced nothing.

findings.finding: The city view listed Mexico City and San Francisco as possible links that the options then did not offer.
findings.fix: Both would have crossed an existing supply line, which the rules forbid. The board and city views now say why a link is not possible.

findings.finding: An Unrationed Event played in February was missing from March's deck.
findings.fix: The research rule: an Unrationed Event is destroyed when played. The guide had said it is always in the deck, and now says until played.

findings.finding: Record Keeper was on a character for two games and nobody could tell what it did.
findings.fix: Status lists every job, ability and scar at the table with its rule, and marks which are passive.

findings.finding: Exposure logged as 'empty', and improved cards showed only a code name.
findings.fix: Exposure results are spelled out. The city view explains each improvement on its cards.

findings.finding: The lobby map did not show the permanent supply center.
findings.fix: Permanent structures show between games.

findings.finding: The lead confirmed supplies and purchases before the others' objections arrived.
findings.fix: The guide tells the lead to state the plan and wait once before confirming.

findings.finding: Tripoli held more cubes than its population. Restore was not for sale. Zero events could be picked.
findings.fix: All three are the rules as researched. The guide now says each.

g03.summary: Lost on turn 9 at eight incidents, but found and reached the eastern Pacific haven and completed two of three objectives.
g03.story: Vex led, with the same table: Knox the Laborer, Hale the Radio Operator, Quinn the Administrator. The lead wanted to rebalance the opening cubes, could not take any back, and confirmed a layout that left Atlanta empty. The opening infection then stripped Jacksonville and Los Angeles. Knox opened with two searches in Los Angeles. The second sighted a haven out in the eastern Pacific, and Knox charted the year's first sea lane to it and walked in, which completed both Perform 2 searches and Access a lost haven. London was the only new supply center. An epidemic stripped Lagos, Hale sailed to Cairo and saved it, and Istanbul and Lagos took the last two plague cubes on one Infect step.
highlights: The lost haven of the eastern Pacific, found by a sea search at Los Angeles and reached in the same game, two months ahead of its perimeter report.
First sea lane charted, the action unlocked at the end of the previous game.
First forsaken city: Los Angeles ended at population 0, which resolved the first turning point and opened the Forsaken rules. Restore appeared in the shop and the table declined it.
First scar of the year, from an exposure, and the first use of Lockdown to destroy an Infection card for good.
Game end: London's center made permanent, Foreman bought for Knox. Rationing rises to 4 for April.
g03.parity: All four checks passed against the research for March. No Legacy card was due and none was read. The search opened the eastern Pacific haven's sighting and the arrival opened its contents, including the stockpile bonus, which under the fix made earlier landed in this game. The first turning point resolved at game end when a city stood at population 0, which is when the research timeline schedules it. Epidemic scaling was active from this game, as card 03-02 set.

findings.finding: Lockdown destroyed an Infection card and nothing said so. Two players reported the card as lost by a bug.
findings.fix: The game logs which card Lockdown destroyed. Test added.

findings.finding: The lead could not take setup cubes back, so a layout the table had rejected was confirmed.
findings.fix: The engine always allowed it. The lab's supply command now takes a negative count or an exact amount (=2), and the setup view says so.

findings.finding: A refused command still ended with success, so a chained command ran on into confirm.
findings.fix: A refusal is now an error to the shell and stops the chain.

findings.finding: Scar choices were bare keys with slot numbers and no names.
findings.fix: Each choice says which scar, what it does, whose character, and what it would cover.

findings.finding: The briefing announced Second Wind as new when one was already in the reserve.
findings.fix: A briefing now says when a card is another copy.

findings.finding: The playtest flavor line for forsaken cities said the city is struck from the rolls, which reads as removed from the board.
findings.fix: Rewritten. A forsaken city stays on the board and can be restored.

findings.finding: Well Stocked protected one Infection card, not every stocked city.
findings.fix: The improvement belongs to the card it was bought for.

g04.summary: Lost on turn 11 at eight incidents, one supply center short. South America was forced open and the Opal lab was found.
g04.story: Sol led as Hale the Radio Operator, with Knox the Laborer and Sable the Instructor back in. The April perimeter report opened South America for the players, because nobody had reconned it: Buenos Aires started on the grid, with Bogotá, Lima and Santiago off it. This time the lead could move setup cubes, and shifted two after Kit objected. Knox joined Bogotá and Lima on the first turn, which completed Connect 2 new cities, then searched Buenos Aires twice. The first box found the Opal lab, which unlocked Inoculate and added 15 cubes to the stockpile on the spot. The second finished the search objective. Knox built Atlanta and Istanbul. Three epidemics later the rate was 3, and bare Cairo was the first flip of the step that filled the track.
highlights: First forced opening: the perimeter report opened South America at setup. The explorer's reward event was lost and the opening counted toward no objective, as the research rules say.
The Opal lab, found by a land search at Buenos Aires. Its stockpile bonus landed in the same game: the stockpile went from 11 to 26.
First Inoculate: Sable stored a São Paulo Infection card out of the decks.
Card Swap and the Instructor's give were both used to route cards to the builder.
Game end: card 04-02 put Rebirth on sale. The table spent all 4 units restoring Cairo and Los Angeles, the first Restore purchases.
g04.parity: All four checks passed: 3 objectives required; the five March objectives still in play; 27 cubes. Card 04-01 was read at setup and forced South America, which the research schedules for April and not March, where it was only a warning. Card 04-02 was read at game end. Epidemic scaling set the epidemic count from this month, as the research notes. The Opal lab arrived by the trigger the research gives, a land search on the Buenos Aires card.

findings.finding: Inoculate ran with no explanation: the briefing named no rule, the log said only 'inoculate', and a stored card simply vanished.
findings.fix: A briefing now explains every new action and rule in one line. The log says which card went into storage.

findings.finding: The stockpile jumped by 15 with nothing in the log.
findings.fix: The log says how many cubes moved from the reserve.

findings.finding: Rebirth's text did not say what the improvement does.
findings.fix: Rewritten: when the card is drawn while its city has population 4 or more, it does nothing.

findings.finding: `wait` said it was waiting on Knox during setup, when it was waiting on the lead.
findings.fix: It names the lead outside of turns.

findings.finding: Supply lines refused for crossing another line, and nine cities infected at setup, both unexplained.
findings.fix: The guide covers the opening infection and the no-crossing rule.

findings.finding: Inoculate offered a discarded Player card as well as Infection cards. An Instructor's card was taken on another player's turn. Card Swap let its player choose both cards.
findings.fix: Each matches the research or the card's text.

g05.summary: Lost on turn 11 at eight incidents with two supply centers built. Fourth loss in a row, which triggered the relief turning point.
g05.story: Kit led with Sable the Instructor, Vex kept Knox the Laborer, and Sol took the Immunologist, the new job the Opal lab had brought. With the lab's bonus the table had 42 cubes and put at least two on every city, but the opening infection hit Lima and Bogotá twice each and emptied both. Knox built Istanbul and then Lagos. The Immunologist made supplies straight from the reserve and inoculated four Infection cards into storage, both of Lima's among them, and played Stock Up. It was not enough: San Francisco took the seventh incident, and Bogotá, already at two Plague cubes with its last card still in the discard pile, was struck by an epidemic and filled the track.
highlights: First game with a job found during the campaign: the Immunologist, whose Make Supplies draws on the reserve.
Inoculate used as a strategy: four Infection cards stored out of the decks in one game.
The Opal lab's bonus arrived at setup as the research says: 27 cubes plus 15.
Four losses in a row resolved the second turning point: 10 relief cubes for each of the next 3 games.
Three cities ended forsaken: Jacksonville, Denver and San Francisco. The table bought Rebirth, Record Keeper and Well Stocked.
g05.parity: All four checks passed, including the supply check with the lab's bonus: 27 + 15 = 42 cubes. No Legacy card was due. The losing-streak turning point resolved after the fourth straight loss, which is its researched trigger, and gives 10 cubes a game for 3 games (the one figure the research has). Restored cities stayed infested, which the research states is permanent.

findings.finding: The losing-streak turning point resolved and nothing told the players.
findings.fix: The game-end briefing now announces it and what it gives. The audit now tracks both turning points.

findings.finding: Restore left Cairo and Los Angeles marked infested, which read as a bug.
findings.fix: The research rule: infested is permanent. The shop text and the guide now say so.

findings.finding: Rebirth's text still did not say what the card does.
findings.fix: Rewritten again: the city is not infected, no cube lost, no Plague cube.

findings.finding: Inoculated cards could not be seen anywhere afterwards.
findings.fix: The decks view lists what is in storage.

findings.finding: Inoculate offered a city's discarded Player cards as well as its Infection cards.
findings.fix: The research rule covers both piles. The briefing line added last game says so.

findings.finding: The opening infection hit two cities twice. A city at two Plague cubes took a third without an outbreak.
findings.fix: Nine cards are flipped, not nine cities. An outbreak needs a city already at three. The guide now says nine cards.

g06.summary: Won on turn 15 with four incidents: three supply centers, Europe reconned from London, and two new cities joined.
g06.story: Vex led as Knox the Laborer, with Sol's Immunologist and Kit's Sable the Instructor. The table had 49 cubes: May's 24, the lab's 15 and 10 in relief after four straight losses, and eight Rationed Events at rationing 8. The opening infection logged twelve flips, because three cards belonged to forsaken cities and were set aside for replacements. Knox built Lagos, Istanbul and São Paulo. The Immunologist kept inoculating Infection cards and making supplies from the reserve. Knox then reconned Europe from London with four different blue cards, which put Paris on the grid and finished Connect 2 new cities in the same stroke.
highlights: The losing streak is broken. Relief cubes and a full hand of events turned the game.
Europe revealed by the players in May, a month before its perimeter report, so Frankfurt is not lost in June.
Forsaken cities behaved as researched: their Infection cards were set aside and replaced, at setup and in play.
Game end: Cairo and Mexico City fell to population 0. Card 05-02 put Architect, Courier and Scout on sale and the table bought all three, one for each character.
Rationing drops to 6 for June.
g06.parity: All four checks passed, with the supply check reading 24 + 15 lab bonus + 10 relief = 49. Card 05-01 was read at setup: its perimeter report is for the eastern Pacific haven, which the players had already found in March, so it forced nothing. Card 05-02 was read at game end and unlocked the three abilities the research lists for May. The Europe recon needed 4 blue cards of different cities at a London supply center, as researched.

findings.finding: Card Swap logged that it was played but not which cards moved.
findings.fix: The log names the target of every event: who was airlifted where, which cards were swapped, which city was purged. Test added.

findings.finding: Picking events answered every bad list with 'Pick 8', without naming the bad id or the legal ones.
findings.fix: The command says which ids are not in the reserve, how many to name, and lists the reserve.

findings.finding: The lead's `wait` returned at once, so plans from the other two arrived after supplies were confirmed.
findings.fix: New `listen` command blocks until another player speaks. The guide tells the lead to use it before confirming.

findings.finding: During setup the city view called every Player card out of play.
findings.fix: It says not dealt yet.

findings.finding: The opening infection logged 12 flips. Forsaken cities kept their cubes.
findings.fix: The research rule: a forsaken city's card is set aside and another is flipped. The guide now explains it.

findings.finding: Inoculate again offered a city's discarded Player cards. An Instructor's card was taken on the taker's turn.
findings.fix: Both follow the research. The Inoculate options now say which pile each card comes from.

g07.summary: Won on turn 9 with one incident, the cleanest game of the year so far.
g07.story: Sol led with the Immunologist, beside Knox the Laborer and Sable the Instructor, each carrying the ability bought in May. With 46 cubes and six events the table went straight for the objectives. Knox drew supply lines from Istanbul to Frankfurt and to St. Petersburg in the opening turns, which completed Connect 2 new cities. The Immunologist stored Istanbul and Washington Infection cards as they came up. A pawn walked into Farwater, the haven found in March, which counts as accessing a lost haven. Supply centers went up in Atlanta, Paris and São Paulo, and the third ended the game with two epidemics drawn and a single Plague cube on the board.
highlights: Three objectives in nine turns: Connect 2 new cities, Access a lost haven, Build 3 supply centers.
Europe paid off at once: Frankfurt and St. Petersburg joined by supply line, and a center built in Paris.
Shuttle Flight was available for the first time, unlocked by Europe's recon.
Card Swap now logs what it moved: Knox gave Istanbul, the Immunologist gave Los Angeles.
Game end: card 06-02 brought two new characters and two Rationed Events. The table made a supply center permanent and bought Facilitator and Runner. Rationing drops to 4.
g07.parity: All four checks passed, with supplies at 21 + 15 lab bonus + 10 relief = 46. Card 06-01 was read at setup: Europe was already open, so its perimeter report forced nothing and Frankfurt was not lost. Card 06-02 was read at game end. The research records no new rules for June, and none arrived. Entering an already-found lost haven completed the objective, which matches the research wording: any haven that is not one of the three starting ones.

findings.finding: Infection odds at setup ranked forsaken cities highest, though their cards are set aside and replaced.
findings.fix: Forsaken cities' cards are left out of the odds, at setup and in play. Test added.

findings.finding: A Courier could deliver only the whole stack to a neighbouring city.
findings.fix: Every count is offered for a neighbouring delivery too. Test added.

findings.finding: The lead expected to confirm supplies with cubes kept back.
findings.fix: The research setup places every cube. The guide now says none may be kept back.

findings.finding: The infection rate was back at 2 after May's three epidemics.
findings.fix: Each game starts clean. The guide now says so.

findings.finding: Any card could be taken from the Instructor on the taker's turn. Inoculate offered Player cards.
findings.fix: Both reported for the third time. The guide now states each in so many words.

g08.summary: Won on turn 13 with four incidents: four objectives, including the new one, towers in three colours.
g08.story: Kit led with the Sanitation Officer, one of June's two new characters, beside Knox the Laborer and the Immunologist. July's perimeter report opened Africa for the players, with Kinshasa, Khartoum and Dar es Salaam infested from the start, and added the Triangulate objective. Knox raised towers in Istanbul, St. Petersburg and Lagos: black, blue and yellow, which completed it. A sea lane from Lagos to Antananarivo and a supply line from St. Petersburg to Moscow completed Connect 2 new cities. A pawn entered Farwater again for the lost haven. The Sanitation Officer searched Bogotá and set a Kinshasa Infection card aside, the Immunologist played Open Waters to join Farwater to Northwatch, and centers in Bogotá, Atlanta and Istanbul finished it, the last one reached by Airlift.
highlights: Triangulate signals completed in the month it arrived: towers in a black, a blue and a yellow city.
First towers and the first Transmit of the year, both unlocked by Africa.
Second forced opening: Africa, by the July perimeter report.
First Sanitation Officer, first Open Waters, first Surplus.
Three wins in a row. Game end made two more supply centers permanent. Rationing drops to 2 for August.
g08.parity: All four checks passed, with supplies at 18 + 15 lab bonus + 10 relief = 43, the last game of relief. Card 07-01 was read at setup and forced Africa, on the month the research gives, and added Triangulate. Card 07-02 was read at game end and added nothing, which matches the research. Triangulate needed blue, yellow and black, the rule fixed from the static review. Washington kept population 8 with a Plague cube on it, because its supply center's gain cancelled the loss, both steps as researched.

findings.finding: The Sanitation Officer's salvage offered a single pair of cards to discard.
findings.fix: Every pair is offered. Test added.

findings.finding: Open Waters listed every sea lane twice, once from each end.
findings.fix: Each lane is offered once. Test added.

findings.finding: Triangulate vanished from the objectives the moment it was completed, and the table could not tell whether it counted.
findings.fix: It counted. The lab now lists a completed objective that has left play, and the briefing says which objectives come and go.

findings.finding: Africa arrived with three infested cities and the briefing did not say so.
findings.fix: A region's briefing names the cities that start infested. Test added.

findings.finding: The deck view hid forsaken cities' Infection cards, after the odds fix from June.
findings.kind: Engine bug, introduced by that fix
findings.fix: The layers show every card again. Only the odds leave forsaken cities out.

findings.finding: The active player's `wait` returned at once while another player owed a discard.
findings.fix: Nothing needs the active player while the game is held up by someone else.

findings.finding: The hint on unlocked actions quoted base costs that Foreman and Architect had lowered. A reason with an apostrophe never reached the game.
findings.fix: The hint says these are base costs. The guide warns about apostrophes.

findings.finding: Washington kept its population with a Plague cube on it. A search card for a forsaken city could not be used.
findings.fix: The supply center's gain cancels the loss. Only Drive or Ferry works in a forsaken city.

g09.summary: Won on turn 8 with two incidents. The Middle East was forced open and the first Hollow Men appeared.
g09.story: Vex led with the Captain, the other of June's new characters, beside the Immunologist and the Sanitation Officer. August's perimeter report opened the Middle East and brought four Hollow Men Gather cards, the Monitor action, and two free units for abilities, which the lead spent at setup on Architect. A pawn stepped into Farwater for the lost haven. The Immunologist stored both of London's and both of Paris's Infection cards, raised a tower in Paris and searched it. Supply lines from Istanbul to Tehran and on to Riyadh completed Connect 2 new cities, and centers in Paris, Frankfurt and St. Petersburg ended it. Along the way the first Hollow Man arrived, in Chicago, flipped in by a Gather card.
highlights: Fourth win in a row, in eight turns.
First Hollow Men of the year: a Gather card turned Chicago's infection into a Hollow Man.
Third forced opening: the Middle East, with Baghdad joined at once.
August's free ability units were spent at setup, the fix made from the static review.

First Captain. Game end: card 08-02 added scars and abilities; the table made Paris's center permanent, the sixth and last allowed, and bought Supplier and Foreman. Rationing drops to 0 for September.
g09.parity: Three checks passed and one differed for a good reason. The research lists Triangulate signals among August's objectives, because the group it follows had not completed it. This group completed it in July, so it had left play. The audit now allows for that. Supplies were 15 + 15 lab bonus = 30, with the relief over. Card 08-01 was read at setup and forced the Middle East on its researched month, with Monitor and the free units. Card 08-02 was read at game end. Gather cards started in the Infection discard pile and turned the next city's flip into a Hollow Man, both as researched.

findings.finding: The Captain and the Runner could only discard the first City card in hand.
findings.fix: Any City card is offered. Test added.

findings.finding: Hollow Men arrived with no explanation: Gather cards sat in the discard pile unannounced, and a city gained a Hollow Man where a cube loss was expected.
findings.fix: The briefing explains Gather cards when they arrive, and the log says when one is flipped. Test added.

findings.finding: Triangulating the signals in July gave nothing, though September's mandatory recon route is behind one of ten Monitor frequencies.
findings.kind: Engine gap, declared earlier as not modelled
findings.fix: Completing Triangulate now names the three frequencies that open something. The players were told the three for this run. Test added.

findings.finding: August's card said the free ability units are spent at game end, while the game offered them at setup.
findings.fix: The card says now, during setup. The lab says an ability bought then is permanent, and shows the offer to every player.

findings.finding: A player ran `pick` after the game had started, and the lab then showed the wrong character against that seat.
findings.fix: Picking is refused outside the lobby, and seats always follow the game.

findings.finding: The trouble list filled with forsaken cities and left out empty live ones.
findings.fix: Forsaken cities are left out and every empty city is listed.

findings.finding: After Paris was made permanent, the other permanent center options vanished.
findings.fix: Six permanent supply centers is the limit. The guide now says so.

findings.finding: A city at population 1 took Plague cubes without becoming forsaken. A search card could not be used in a forsaken city.
findings.fix: Population changes at game end. Only Drive or Ferry works in a forsaken city.

g10.summary: Won on turn 12 with two incidents: East Asia reconned from Kolkata a month ahead of its deadline.
g10.story: Sol led with the Immunologist, beside the Captain and Knox the Laborer. September made Recon East Asia mandatory, and its route was unknown. The perimeter report opened the Indian Ocean haven for the players, which added 15 more cubes for a table total of 42. With the hint from July's triangulation, the table drew a supply line from Tehran to Kolkata, raised a tower in Istanbul and tuned Monitor to frequency 4, which revealed the route. The recon from Kolkata opened East Asia, put Jakarta on the grid, and completed Connect 2 new cities with it. Two more Monitors opened new card improvements and new training. Hollow Men kept arriving, three Gather cards at a time, and a shelter went up in Tehran. Centers in Frankfurt, Moscow and Lagos finished the game.
highlights: Five wins in a row. East Asia opened by the players in September, so October's forced opening and its scar will not happen.
First Monitor: all three useful frequencies were used in one game. Two of them each discarded an Epidemic unresolved, as the research says Monitor does.
First shelter, built in Tehran, the action East Asia unlocked. The first Hollow Men at setup: the last 3 opening infections placed figures.
The Indian Ocean haven was forced open by the perimeter report and reached, with its 15-cube bonus.
Game end: Navigator, Surveyor, Investigator and a Red Wild improvement. Rationing stays at 0.
g10.parity: All four checks passed: 3 objectives required, with Build 3 supply centers and Recon East Asia both mandatory, as the research sets for September; supplies 12 + 30 in bonuses = 42. Card 09-01 was read at setup: Recon a new area left play, the Indian Ocean haven was forced, stored cards now come back through Epidemics, and the last 3 setup infections placed Hollow Men. Card 09-02 was read at game end. The Kolkata route was hidden behind a Monitor frequency, as the research describes. The recording was used to check two reports: cubes did leave Moscow and Buenos Aires on each hit, and the exposure at Tehran came on leaving it.

findings.finding: The briefing for the newly revealed route gave only its title, not where or what it costs.
findings.fix: A briefing now states a new recon route's city, cards and whether it needs a supply center.

findings.finding: London and São Paulo ended with a Plague cube and no population loss, and Riyadh lost 1 with three Hollow Men.
findings.fix: A supply center's gain cancels the loss, and a city loses at most 1 a game. The game-end view now explains each such city.

findings.finding: The Universal improvement was announced but not in the shop.
findings.fix: It cost more than the units left. The game-end view now lists what is for sale but out of reach.

findings.finding: Infections were reported as removing no cube, and an exposure as coming on entering a city.
findings.fix: The recording shows the cube leaving on each hit and the exposure on leaving Tehran.

findings.finding: Three Hollow Men cards in a row placed one figure, not three. Monitor discarded Epidemics without resolving them.
findings.fix: Both as researched: the next city gets one figure, and a monitored Epidemic has no effect.

g11.summary: Lost on turn 14 at eight incidents, with two supply centers built and the Hollow Men not yet turned. The win streak ends at five.
g11.story: Kit led with Knox the Laborer, beside the Captain and the Immunologist. October asks for two things, both mandatory: three supply centers, and a Hollow Man standing in each of three different havens, moved there with the new Broadcast action from tower cities. The opening infection placed Hollow Men on Kolkata, Baghdad and Buenos Aires. The Captain played Safe Houses, which was meant to place three shelters and placed one. Towers went up in São Paulo, Antananarivo and Washington, and Knox and the Captain broadcast four times. Centers were built in Lagos and Frankfurt. What broke the table was September's rule: each of the four epidemics pulled an inoculated Infection card back out of storage and struck its city, Istanbul, Antananarivo, London and Lagos in turn, and London's second Plague cube was the eighth incident.
highlights: First Broadcast: Hollow Men moved toward the havens four times, without reaching three of them.
The cost of inoculating all year: with 25 Infection cards in storage, every Epidemic now strikes one of those cities and puts its card back in the deck.
Rationing 0 again: no event cards except Safe Houses, the Unrationed reward for reconning East Asia.
No scar and no forced opening this month, because East Asia was reconned in September.
Game end: Outrider and a permanent shelter, the first one, newly allowed by October's card.
g11.parity: All four checks passed: 2 objectives required, Build 3 supply centers and Turn the Hollow Men both mandatory; supplies 8 + 30 in bonuses = 38. Card 10-01 was read at setup: East Asia's perimeter report found the region open and forced nothing, the September objectives left play, Broadcast and permanent shelters arrived. Card 10-02 was read at game end and added nothing, as researched. Epidemics drew from storage first, which is the September rule the research records.

findings.finding: Safe Houses says up to 3 shelters and placed 1, because only single cities could be named.
findings.fix: A choice with several targets is one key with the targets joined by +. The engine always took up to three cities. Test added.

findings.finding: Epidemics struck cities whose Infection cards were all in storage, and nothing said the card had come from there.
findings.fix: The log says when an Epidemic pulls a card out of storage. The lab's storage line states the rule once it is in play.

findings.finding: Riyadh reached 3 Plague cubes without an outbreak.
findings.fix: An outbreak needs a hit on a city already at 3. The guide said it loosely and is corrected.

findings.finding: Two Hollow Men cards in a row placed one figure.
findings.fix: As researched. The guide now says several in a row place one figure.

findings.finding: The opening infection placed Hollow Men with no Gather card flipped.
findings.fix: September's rule: the last 3 setup infections place Hollow Men.

g12.summary: Won on turn 11 with one incident: the Hollow Men turned and three supply centers built.
g12.story: Vex led with the Captain, beside the Immunologist and the Sanitation Officer. The table renamed its Mediterranean haven Crosswater. The opening infection placed Hollow Men on Istanbul, São Paulo and Lagos, each next door to a haven. With so many Infection cards in storage and five cities forsaken, the Infection deck ran out on the second turn and was rebuilt from its discard pile, which moved the infection rate a step with no Epidemic drawn. Towers in Istanbul and São Paulo let the Sanitation Officer and the Captain broadcast Hollow Men into the havens, and the third haven completed Turn the Hollow Men and opened the defection. Centers in Frankfurt, St. Petersburg and New York, with a Quiet Night to cover the last turn, won it.
highlights: The Hollow Men defect: a figure in each of three different havens, the October objective under the researched rule.
The Infection deck ran out and reshuffled before any Epidemic, the first time the year has seen that rule.
First haven renamed by the table.
A sea lane charted from Northwatch to São Paulo.
Game end: Cordon, Soldier and a second Record Keeper. Rationing drops to 0 for November.
g12.parity: All four checks passed, the same as the first attempt: 2 objectives, both mandatory, and 38 cubes. No Legacy card was due. Completing Turn the Hollow Men opened the defection content, which is the third turning point in the research, folded into the objective here. An empty Infection deck was reshuffled and the rate marker advanced one space, which is the rulebook rule in the research notes.

findings.finding: The infection rate moved a step with no Epidemic drawn, and nothing said why.
findings.fix: It is the rule for an empty Infection deck. The log now says when the deck runs out and is reshuffled, and the guide explains it.

findings.finding: Several Hollow Men cards in a row logged one line each for a single figure.
findings.fix: One line.

findings.finding: A renamed haven kept its old name in the city view.
findings.fix: The city view uses the name the table gave.

findings.finding: Build Shelter was not offered in a haven, and its key read as if the shelter went to the city on the card.
findings.fix: The research rule needs a card of the city's colour, and a haven has none. The option now says the shelter goes where you stand and what the card is for.

findings.finding: Opening odds read 67% for each of nine live cities that were all hit.
findings.fix: The figure is the chance of losing a cube. The setup view now says the last 3 flips place Hollow Men.

g13.summary: Lost on turn 14 at eight incidents without a single recon. The table never reached Shanghai.
g13.story: Sol led with the Immunologist, beside the Captain and the Sanitation Officer. November has one objective: complete the Plan, four recons at Shanghai, each paid in a different colour. Shanghai was revealed but off the grid, and getting there was the whole game. The straight lines from Delhi and from Tehran both cross ground nobody has revealed, so the rules refuse them. The one open line runs from Kolkata, and Kolkata was forsaken, where only Drive or Ferry works. The table drew Tehran to Delhi, Lagos to Dar es Salaam, sea lanes on to the Indian Ocean haven, New Mumbai and Jakarta, and found Jakarta forsaken too. With 34 cubes, no events and three epidemics pulling cards out of storage, the incident track filled while they were still looking for a way east.
highlights: The stricter connection rules shaped the game on their first day: two tempting lines to Shanghai were refused for crossing unexplored map.
Forsaken cities became a wall. Kolkata and Jakarta, the two gateways to East Asia, could not be built from.
The Indian Ocean haven, renamed Monsoon Rest, was joined to the grid by sea from Dar es Salaam.
First Strike: the Soldier ability removed a Hollow Man in Lagos. First Cordon: Sol discarded a card to call off the rest of an Infect step.
Game end: the table bought Restore, to reopen a gateway for the second attempt, and Scout.
g13.parity: All four checks passed: 1 objective required, Complete the Plan, mandatory; supplies 4 + 30 in bonuses = 34. Card 11-01 was read at setup, removed Build 3 supply centers and Turn the Hollow Men, and revealed the four recon routes at Shanghai with their costs. Card 11-02 was read at game end and added nothing, as researched. A forsaken city allowed only Drive or Ferry, which is the researched rule and the reason the open line from Kolkata could not be drawn.

findings.finding: A character took the same scar twice, and the second copy covered an ability.
findings.fix: A character cannot take a scar it already carries. Test added.

findings.finding: Cordon ended an Infect step and the log said nothing, so another player's Cordon was refused with no visible reason.
findings.fix: The log says who called off the step with Cordon, who kept a cube with a shield, and where a Hollow Man was removed. Test added.

findings.finding: The city view said a link was blocked only because its end was off the grid. Once that city was joined, the real block appeared: unexplored map.
findings.fix: The map's own blocks are named first, whether or not an end is on the grid, and a forsaken end is called out.

findings.finding: An infection was logged as blocked with no reason.
findings.fix: The log names the improvement on the card that blocked it.

findings.finding: No line could be drawn out of forsaken Kolkata or Jakarta. A Cordon card drawn at setup asked nothing. An Epidemic on an empty city placed no Plague cube.
findings.fix: All three are the researched rules.

g14.summary: Lost on turn 17 at eight incidents with two of the four Plan recons done. The Plan was not completed in November.
g14.story: Kit led with the Sanitation Officer, beside the Captain and the Immunologist. With Kolkata restored, the table drew the supply line from Kolkata to Shanghai in the opening turns and the Sanitation Officer made the yellow recon there. Lines went on to Hong Kong, Bangkok and Ho Chi Minh City to bring red cards into the deck, a shelter went up in Kolkata so a pawn could sleep there, and a tower in Kolkata let the Captain Monitor for cards. The black recon followed. The red recon needs five red cards of different cities and the blue needs three, and the cards did not come: three epidemics, pulling stored cards back out each time, filled the track on turn 17.
highlights: The Plan begun: yellow and black recons made at Shanghai. Steps of the Plan are permanent, so they carried to the end of the month.
Shanghai joined to the grid from Kolkata, the one line the map allowed, after the gateway city was restored.
Scavenge and Monitor both threw Epidemics away unresolved, which is what their rules say and what nobody at the table expected.
A search at Tehran let the table remove Hollow Men.
Game end: a permanent shelter, the Universal improvement and Foreman. The Plan was not finished, so December opens Utopia for the players and its reward is lost.
g14.parity: The checks passed as in the first attempt: 1 objective, Complete the Plan, and 34 cubes. No Legacy card was due. Each recon at Shanghai opened its Plan step and counted toward the objective, with no supply center needed there, as researched. With the Plan unfinished after both November games, December's card forces Utopia, which matches the research: Utopia joins the grid and its Infection cards start in the discard pile.

findings.finding: Monitor and Scavenge discarded cards, Epidemics among them, and the log named none of them.
findings.fix: The log lists what Monitor revealed and what Scavenge kept and discarded, and says a discarded Epidemic has no effect.

findings.finding: Nobody could say what a tower does, months after towers arrived.
findings.fix: New `actions` command lists what every unlocked action and added rule does.

findings.fix: The hint on unlocked actions gives the shelter's cost.

findings.fix: The prompt points at the exact key in the options.

findings.finding: A Cordon card flipped at setup asked nothing. Shanghai arrived infested.
findings.fix: Setup is not an Infect step, and Shanghai is infested from the start. Regions revealed from now on name their infested cities in the briefing.

g15.summary: Won on turn 15 with seven incidents: the sample was carried from Lake Baikal to Johannesburg. The campaign is complete.
g15.story: Vex led with Hale the Radio Operator, back at the table for the last game, beside the Immunologist and the Sanitation Officer. The Plan had not been finished, so December's card opened Utopia for the players, with its eight Infection cards waiting in the discard pile. The Immunologist stored six of them and the Sanitation Officer set two more aside with Resilience, so Utopia never came up. Hale was airlifted to Tehran and drew a supply line straight to Utopia, then on to Lake Baikal, which opened the Pearl lab. On the far side of the map a line from Dar es Salaam reached Johannesburg and a supply center went up there. Hale took the sample on turn 12: three exposure boxes scratched, the third a scar, and the Carrier scar covered two of his abilities. He then drove home across the grid, paying a card of each city's colour to enter it, while the Sanitation Officer struck Hollow Men out of his path. He reached Johannesburg on turn 15 with the incident track one short of full.
highlights: The final objective completed on the first attempt: self-infection at the Pearl lab, the carrier's restricted movement, and delivery to a supply center in Johannesburg.
Utopia forced open at December setup with its Infection cards in the discard pile, as the research says for an unfinished Plan.
The carrier died at game end, as the rule says.
Final score 545: 430 for games won, 80 population, 100 for the sample, 50 for two labs, minus 115 for 23 forsaken cities.

The year: 16 games, 9 won and 7 lost. January, February, May, June, July, August, September and December were won at the first attempt, October at the second. March, April and November were lost twice.
g15.parity: All four checks passed: 1 objective required, Deliver the sample, mandatory; supplies 0 + 30 in bonuses = 30. Card 12-01 was read at setup: it forced Utopia, replaced the Plan with the sample objective, revealed Lake Baikal, added the carrier rule and two Assemble cards. Card 12-02 was read at game end and the campaign was scored. Lake Baikal could be joined only from Utopia, the fix made from the static review. Across the year all 24 Legacy cards were read in their own month.
